desc: Featuring LINK System technology, the GASCAP USB-C Tailcap marks a paradigm shift for switching technology, bringing USB-C capabilities to weapon mounted lights and switches. The robust performance of the LINK System interface provides near-zero-loss output and dependable, repeatable activation. The lateral and reversible interface on the GASCAP provides a variety of mounting and cable management options, while its cage protects the cable and ensures a solid lockup. GASCAP features an onboard full-size latching button for momentary or constant activation of your device. Made of high-impact polymer, GASCAP is durable in even the most austere environments.
